summary: Defines how to use a JSON Web Token (JWT) as a bearer credential with OAuth 2.0, either to request an access token or to authenticate a client. It is a profile of the assertion framework in RFC 7521 and is widely used for service-to-service authentication.

eli5.summary: A program shows a small signed note, called a token, to prove who it is, instead of typing a password. The server checks the signature and hands back a pass to use its services.
